topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: It seems the order of the day is particularly off-kilter. My car, which has rested quietly in my driveway countless mornings, was absent when I stepped out. The spot where I left it, now empty, offers a stark reminder of the inconvenience that awaits. A note, stuck to my door, informs me of the tow. The logic behind it escapes me, much like the understanding of many of the day's peculiarities. I find myself tracing the outlines of this disruption, contemplating the steps to rectify this situation, all while the world outside carries on, indifferent to the rhythm it has stolen.
